## Verification after any change

```bash
npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json scripts/learn/english-bank/audit-served.ts   # regenerates this file and the json files
node scripts/learn/english-bank/build-kits.mjs                                     # rebuild kits from the sources
node scripts/learn/build-content-assets.mjs                                        # manifest + assets
UPDATE_COVERAGE=1 npx vitest run tests/learn/coverage-table.test.ts                 # coverage from what the service really serves
npx vitest run
```
